Choose zero or more balls so that the number of black balls chosen is the number of white balls chosen. If the maximum sum would be negative, you can instead choose zero black balls and zero white balls (satisfying the >= constraint) for a sum of 0. Among all such choices, find the maximum possible sum of the values of the chosen balls. Constraints - 1 \leq N,M \leq 2\times 10^5 - -10^9 \leq B_i, W_j \leq 10^9 - All input values are integers.
